notes: cfg is tests/fixtures/frozen/quartos.json; in PHP, the rule set of tests/fixtures/presets/parity.json. The configuration without the rules of later milestones, which the parity preset leaves out too: dated owner exceptions to the safety limit, per-room holiday floors and the sales ladder. One run of pace.plano over synthetic calendars, one case per room night. Owner orders are empty; the owner's dated plan (plano_da_noite) and the pass of relations between rooms (coerencia) are switched off in memory, because both belong to a later milestone. Sold-out nights are left to the protection rule of that milestone (regra_j_ativa only keeps the reference from writing a protection item). pousada_noite = [sold, units] of every room of the same property that night; base_vendidas/base_total = what the engine measured the pace over. expected = {fora (esgotada, sem_ancora or null), linha (the diagnosis of the night, as the engine rounds it), item (what would be written, or null)}.
